title: Everything is an Operational View: UI as a Projection over Context in Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.17355v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emergence of generative AI has enabled Generative User Interfaces (GenUI) that dynamically construct interfaces from user intent, yet existing approaches rely on request-response pipelines that fragment context and limit transparency and control. This paper proposes AFS-UI, which reconceptualises UI as projections over context built on an agentic file-system abstraction that organizes data, capabilities, and interaction state within a unified, persistent workspace. In particular, AFS-UI addresses key limitations in current systems, including heterogeneous resource discoverability, incompatible operation semantics, tangling projection and context, rigid source composition and substitution, and limited evolvability. Within this framework, interfaces become dynamic, inspectable views over shared resources, supporting both human and agent interaction through a common operational surface.

translated_title: 一切皆是操作视图：智能体系统中作为上下文投影的用户界面
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能的兴起催生了能够根据用户意图动态构建界面的生成式用户界面，但现有方法依赖于请求-响应管道，这种管道割裂了上下文并限制了透明度与控制能力。本文提出AFS-UI，将用户界面重新概念化为基于智能体文件系统抽象构建的上下文投影，该抽象在统一、持久的工作空间中组织数据、能力和交互状态。特别地，AFS-UI解决了当前系统中的关键局限性，包括异构资源的可发现性不足、操作语义不兼容、投影与上下文相互纠缠、数据源组合与替换机制僵化以及可演化性受限等问题。在该框架下，界面成为共享资源之上动态、可检查的视图，通过统一操作界面同时支持人类与智能体的交互。
tldr: 本文提出AFS-UI框架，将用户界面重新概念化为智能体文件系统之上的上下文投影，使界面成为对共享资源的动态可检查视图，从而通过统一操作界面同时支持人类与智能体的交互。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AFS-UI, which reconceptualizes UI as a projection over context built on an agentic file-system abstraction, turning interfaces into dynamic, inspectable views over shared resources that support both human and agent interaction through a common operational surface.
